sections.title: Home page load and accessibility
sections.what: Checks the home page loads with status 200, shows the ALTER EGO text, logs no errors, and passes accessibility checks after animations finish.
sections.why: Likely reason: catches obvious breakage and accessibility regressions on the first page visitors see.
sections.watch_out: Any console error fails the first test, so an outside script's warning can break it.

summary: Two quick checks of the home page: it loads with no browser errors, and it passes accessibility checks once animations settle.
purpose: Catches a broken home page early, both for script errors and for accessibility problems.
why: Reason stated in a comment: entrance animations fade content in, so the test waits for them to finish before scanning.
how: The first test records console and page errors, loads the home page, expects status 200 and the text ALTER EGO, waits for network to be idle, and expects no errors. The second test loads the page, waits until no animations are running, and runs an accessibility scan at four WCAG levels.
inputs: A running app with the home page.
risks: Any console error fails the first test, including harmless warnings logged as errors by outside scripts.
debug: If the error test fails, read the error messages it prints. If the accessibility test times out, look for animations that never finish.
